title: Tiles at zoom 18 render with 1px seams
body: At z18 and above, adjacent PNG tiles show a 1px transparent seam on the right and bottom edges. Started after #98 switched the renderer to integer tile bounds. Repro: GET /tiles/18/41920/101330.png and its right neighbour, place side by side. Expected: no gap.

title: Add WebP output
body: Serve .webp when the client asks for it. Smaller tiles for mobile.

title: Cache eviction drops hot tiles under load
body: Under ~2k rps the LRU evicts tiles that were hit seconds ago. Hit rate falls from 92% to 40%.

title: Crash on empty GeoJSON FeatureCollection
body: POST /render with {"type":"FeatureCollection","features":[]} panics with index out of range in bbox().

title: Wrong Content-Type for .pbf tiles
body: Vector tiles are served as text/plain. They should be application/x-protobuf, and MapLibre refuses to decode them behind our CDN, which sniffs the type. See server/handlers.go contentTypeFor().
